categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through prompt payment by the offender. Advances the softgoal Maximize timely fine revenue (Make +100) and helps Minimize administrative and enforcement cost (Help +50), judged against performance indicators like Average time to case closure.
categories.rationale: Traced 1:1 to declared alternative id=12 as a primary path of fine case resolution.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through delayed payment after penalties are applied. Helps maximize timely fine revenue (Help +50).
categories.rationale: Traced 1:1 to declared alternative id=13 representing resolution after penalty application.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Resolution of the case through an administrative appeal lodged with the Prefecture. Preserves offender's due-process rights (Help +50) while incurring administrative costs and impacting revenue.
categories.rationale: Traced 1:1 to declared alternative id=14 representing administrative review paths.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Resolution of the case through a judicial appeal brought before a Judge. Strongly preserves offender's due-process rights (Make +100) but hurts minimization of administrative and enforcement costs.
categories.rationale: Traced 1:1 to declared alternative id=19 representing judicial review paths.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Resolution of the case through enforced coercive credit collection procedures. Helps maximize revenue (Help +50) but hurts administrative cost minimization and due-process preservation.
categories.rationale: Traced 1:1 to declared alternative id=20 representing coercive closure paths.
